name: Vartech Systems Inc.
summary: VarTech Systems Inc. specializes in the development and distribution of robust computing and display technologies. Their comprehensive product line includes LCD flat panel displays, industrial-grade monitors, computers, workstations, and integrated HMI panel mount computer systems. Offerings span a wide range, from touchscreens, durable industrial monitors and PCs, and specialized panels and enclosures, to public access kiosks, mobile computers, and compact IPCs. They also provide systems tailored for mission-critical applications and sunlight-readable displays, all engineered to perform reliably in the most demanding indoor and outdoor settings. Additionally, VarTech produces computer products and panel PCs specifically certified for hazardous, explosion-proof, and non-incendive environments. Beyond hardware sales, the company offers repair and replacement services for both CRT and LCD units. These diverse solutions cater to numerous industrial sectors, including mining, maritime operations, oil and gas, food processing, pharmaceuticals, vehicle-mounted systems, transportation, process control, and automation. Founded in 1988, VarTech Systems Inc. is based in Baton Rouge, Louisiana.
